artifacts.summary: 4-phase, 4.75-hour plan: widen the batch gate deferral directive from the plan's final phase to every full-tier phase, align plan-format.md/batch-gate-stage.md contract prose, add a contention-detected (annotation-only) signal to gate 8's lock/load path, redeploy and run the complete gate set.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, any new content added to orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's composed dispatch file must be weighed against orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's cycle_plan_dispatch_hash() normalizer, whose comment block carries a STANDING OBLIGATION to record a 'DECIDED AND RECORDED' note for each such section (stripped as per-cycle boilerplate, or deliberately unstripped as a genuine behavioral signal). The discriminator is whether the content varies per cycle with no real change: plan-DERIVED content is safe to leave unstripped provided the scan is status-marker-independent, because it then varies only when the plan itself changes -- which is exactly when the IDENTICAL DISPATCH HALT should not fire. A status-derived scan would instead vary as phases complete and silently weaken the halt. Precedent: the '## Territory' and '## Outstanding Gate Finding' sections are both deliberately unstripped on the same reasoning.
